title: YT-S1 V07 — YT03 — Mini-documentary: a complete five-minute film
desc:
DIRECTOR CONTRACT (2026-10-15): OUTPOST MARS is paused. Train agents for YouTube automation; this campaign must finish with at least TEN distinct good-quality five-minute videos. Topics are agent-chosen; narration and captions are ENGLISH. Read projects/youtube-training/README.md, ACCEPTANCE.md and TRAINING.md before starting. All shared storage is now dreamer2664/storagecode (PUSHES.md, shifts/, data/, wire/ and Releases for large media); dreamer2664/storage is retired/read-only. No paid service, Director PC or Mars component is a hidden prerequisite. Multi-shift job: claim a bounded lease, heartbeat real checkpoints, and leave an executable handoff. Branch agent/<you>/<task-id>; PR/evidence/two non-owner ballots; no blind or self ballots. Planning estimates are not artificial minimum work timers.

ESTIMATED EFFORT: 8–20 focused hours (planning, not a timer).
SLOT: YT03. FORMAT TRAINING: Mini-documentary. Choose an evergreen subject; construct chronology and causal context, handle uncertainties and image rights, and avoid invented dramatic scenes.
DELIVER ONE COMPLETE VIDEO, not just preparatory files: a distinct agent-chosen subject, real 300–330s 1920×1080 H.264/AAC MP4, intelligible English narration, synchronized English SRT/VTT + transcript, final thumbnail, upload-ready truthful title/description/chapters/credits and editable/reproducible source project. Topic and audience promise must be reserved on the V01 slate without collision. At least three credible sources, a timestamped claim ledger, and documented rights for every external asset. Plan roughly 650–800 spoken words but time the actual performance; no silence/loop/credit padding. Full storyboard (aim ≥20 purposeful shots and ≥3 relevant visual treatments, or a recorded editorial exception).
TRAINING IS REQUIRED: time and edit the script; render a complete rough cut; obtain non-owner timestamped critique; make substantive revisions; archive before/after decisions and a short reusable lesson/postmortem. Independent technical QC plus TWO distinct non-owner full-watch/listen reviews on the exact final hash: each ≥80/100, ≥70% in every category, no critical/major defect. A fresh final hash needs fresh approvals. Run ACCEPTANCE.md audio, caption, source, rights and decode checks; a green code test is not artistic approval.
DELIVERY: working film source under projects/youtube-training/videos/YT03/; small research/QC/review/delivery.json evidence under storagecode/data/youtube-training/yt-training-s1/YT03/; actual large media on Releases of dreamer2664/storagecode with immutable revision names. Bind source commit, exact asset URLs, bytes, SHA-256, duration, recipe/tool versions and approval records. Director must be able to click and watch/download. Record your PUSHES row and shift in storagecode only. Do not mark review with a nonexistent/local-only final asset; report a blocker instead.
DEPENDENCIES: V01–V04 gate final export/delivery. Research, topic proposal, script and storyboard may start immediately while shared tools are being made. No Mars PC/map/bridge dependency. Finish with the actual accepted MP4 or this card is NOT delivered.
OWNS: this slot's film/project and its primary-archive evidence pack. Other films and shared tools belong to their owners; coordinate a narrow bugfix if needed.
